g.text: Every dot is one arm. ρ is Spearman on quality-aligned ranks (↓ metrics negated). Dashed line = least-squares fit, shown only as a visual guide.

g.text: n differs per panel because each metric was computed on a different subset of arms — no imputation, no recompute.
